title: 第3章 珍宝阁主第4章 不知何时离开也不知何时归来
lines: 山呼海啸般的声音震得我心神不宁，眼前的画面也让我惊掉了下巴。
门口外面是一个宽大的平台，平台上空无一物，而平台下面确是一个宽阔的广场，此时广场上已经站满了人影。
这些人奇装异服，形态各异，有的风度翩翩，蓄着长发，有的端庄威严，满含贵气，但是此刻都异常整齐的在广场上排列着，直勾勾的盯着平台上的自己，那种炙热的眼神，仿佛在看自己的爱人。
我很少见到如此多的人，上一次看到还是老头带我去市里面看灯展，那时候也是人山人海，当时自己高兴了很久，这老头子居然舍得花钱了，只是后来自己才听说，那看灯展是不要钱的，就连去市里面坐车都是蹭人家的，而回来的时候，老头根本舍不得坐车，让自己走了很长很长的路。
思绪飘来，我看着下面这群人，忍不住的说道。
“人好多啊！”
话音刚落，站在最前面的一个身穿紫袍的老者就冲着广场后面喊道。
“阁主发话了！
人太多了，尔等金丹修为之下的自行退下，待我等与阁主谈完，尔等再来上前。”
这人中气十足，声音洪亮，就像一个扩音喇叭似的，吼的广场的人鸦雀无声。
但是却没有一人想要退去。
紫袍老者看着没人想退，不由的眼神冰冷了起来。
“我中州第一道门的话就如此不好使了？”
话音落下，下面的人顿时一愣，然后才开始退去，不大一会，整个广场的人就少了一大半，只有少部分的人还站着，眼神炽热的看着自己。
这紫袍老者的话让我心里很纳闷，这是什么地方，还有中州第一道门是个什么地方？
看着剩下的众人，我不禁发声问道。
“你们看我干什么？”
下方众人听到我如此说到，顿时心领神会一般的开始鼓捣，不一会，这些人居然站成了一队，刚下的紫袍老者排在最前面。
只见紫袍老者从手里拿出一个戒指般的东西，嘴里一阵念叨着什么，然后那戒指就发出淡淡的光芒，然后地上就凭空出现了一堆东西。
那些东西慢慢飘台下，我看的一清二楚。
如此神奇的场景让我暗自吃惊，但是现在不知道的东西实在太多了，我只能故作镇定。
只是眼前的东西我却一件都不认识。
有些奇怪的衣服，还有像小孩子吃的药丸，唯一不同的是，这些东西都散发着淡淡的光晕，十分的神奇。
“这都是些什么东西？”
我有些疑惑的问道。
下方的紫袍老者笑眯眯的说道。
“阁主，这些都是我道门的珍宝，有五阶道衣，六阶固型丹，还有些仙草，法器之类的。”
说完老者期待的看着自己。
只是不等我开口，下面就传出一道声音。
“这中州第一道门拿的都是什么破烂玩意？区区六阶丹药就想跟着摆弄了？”
这道声音引得紫袍老者眉头紧锁，但是看到出声之人后，却什么也没说。
自己只是中州道门的先行长老，站在这第一的位置也完全是因为自己的道门，自己确实没有带什么好东西，而自己身后说话的那人，实力强大，道门也完全不须臾自己。
看到紫袍老者不出声，后面的中年男子呵呵一笑，继续说道。
“赶紧的吧，阁主看不上你的破烂，下一位吧。”
如此挑衅的声音，令紫袍老者怒发冲冠。
“王重！
我不理你不代表我怕你！
你三番五次的坏这里的规矩，怕不是要得罪天下所有修行之人吧！”
紫袍的老者的话让这叫王重的一惊，随即扫视了台上的我一眼，悻悻的不再说话。
content_en:
The sound like a roaring mountain and a tsunami made me uneasy, and the picture in front of me also made my jaw drop.
Outside the doorway is a large platform. There is nothing on the platform, but below the platform is indeed a wide square. At this time, the square is already full of people.
These people were dressed in strange clothes and had different shapes. Some were graceful and had long hair, and some were dignified and full of nobility. But at this moment, they were all lined up in the square in an unusually neat manner, staring directly at themselves on the platform, with that burning gaze, as if they were looking at their lover.
I rarely see so many people. The last time I saw it was an old man who took me to the city to see a light show. It was crowded with people at that time. I was happy for a long time. The old man was actually willing to spend money. Only later did I hear that it was free to see the light show. Even taking a bus to the city was a waste of money. When I came back, the old man couldn't bear to take the car and made himself walk a long, long way.
As my thoughts drifted, I looked at the group of people below and couldn't help but say.
"There are so many people!"
As soon as he finished speaking, an old man in purple robe standing at the front shouted to the back of the square.
"The Pavilion Master has spoken!
There are too many people. If you are under the golden elixir cultivation level, please retreat on your own. After I finish talking with the pavilion master, you can come forward again. "
This man was full of energy and had a loud voice, like a loudspeaker, which silenced the people in the square.
But no one wanted to retreat.
The old man in purple robe saw that no one wanted to retreat, and his eyes turned cold.
"Is it so difficult to use the first gate in Zhongzhou?"
After the words fell, the people below were stunned for a moment, and then began to retreat. After a while, more than half of the people in the entire square were reduced, and only a few people were still standing, looking at him with fiery eyes.
The words of the purple-robed old man made me wonder, what kind of place is this, and where is the first gate in Zhongzhou?
Looking at the remaining people, I couldn't help but ask.
"What are you looking at me doing?"
When everyone below heard what I said, they immediately started to tinker with it as if they understood it. After a while, these people actually stood in a line, with the old man in purple robe who had just stepped out of the queue at the front.
I saw the old man in purple robe taking out a ring-like thing from his hand, muttering something in his mouth, and then the ring gave off a faint light, and then a bunch of things appeared out of thin air on the ground.
Those things slowly floated off the stage, and I could see them clearly.
Such a magical scene surprised me secretly, but there are too many things I don’t know now, so I can only pretend to be calm.
But I didn’t recognize anything in front of me.
There are some strange clothes and pills that look like children's pills. The only difference is that these things all exude a faint halo, which is very magical.
"What are these things?"
I asked with some confusion.
The old man in purple robe below said with a smile.
"Pavilion Master, these are the treasures of our Taoist sect, including fifth-level Taoist robes, sixth-level solidifying elixirs, some immortal grass, magical weapons and the like."
After speaking, the old man looked at himself expectantly.
But before I could speak, a voice came from below.
"What kind of junk are they holding at the first door in Zhongzhou? Are you just trying to play with the sixth-level elixir?"
This voice caused the purple-robed old man to frown, but after seeing the person who made the voice, he said nothing.
I am just the forerunner of the Zhongzhou Taoist Sect. I am in this first position entirely because of my Taoist sect. I really don’t bring anything good, and the person who speaks behind me is so powerful that the Taoist sect doesn’t need me at all.
Seeing that the purple-robed old man remained silent, the middle-aged man behind him chuckled and continued.
"Hurry up, the Pavilion Master doesn't like your rags, let's go to the next one."
Such a provocative voice made the purple-robed old man furious.
"Wang Zhong!
Just because I ignore you doesn't mean I'm afraid of you!
If you break the rules here again and again, you probably want to offend all the practitioners in the world! "
Wang Zhong was startled by the words of the purple-robed old man, and then he glanced at me on the stage and stopped talking angrily.
title_en: Chapter 3 Treasure Pavilion Master Chapter 4 I don’t know when I left and I don’t know when I will return.
